content: Top Flutter PDF viewers for page-by-page swipe + pinch-zoom: pdfrx (PDFium-based, actively maintained, cross-platform consistent rendering, published 14 days ago, v2.4.7), pdfx (native_pdf_view successor, PdfViewPinch widget, 526 likes, v2.9.2, last published 13 months ago), flutter_pdfview (basic PDF.js/native wrapper), syncfusion_flutter_pdfviewer (commercial license required, feature-rich). Free non-commercial options: pdfrx and pdfx.
